exposure: resuscitative endovascular balloon occlusion of the aorta
Resuscitative endovascular balloon occlusion of the aorta (REBOA) for placenta accreta spectrum
cohort: 37 patients with placenta accreta spectrum who underwent cesarean hysterectomy
finding: REBOA significantly decreased quantitative blood loss during cesarean hysterectomy in patients with placenta accreta spectrum without significantly increasing operation time.
mod_finding: REBOA significantly decreased quantitative blood loss during cesarean hysterectomy in patients with placenta accreta spectrum.
